name: Colossus V4.1 / material and salvage study
basis: Dome head/body width about 0.3–0.4; helmet/visible-body height about 0.35; detached sleeve in foreground. Perspective prevents absolute measurement.

buried_hip.note: Open irregular pelvic tear with continuous double-sided armour, snapped supports and conduits; no legs.

hidden_geometry: Rear and inner structure inferred; reference shows one frontal three-quarter view.

right_hand.pose: Supinated palm upward, near-horizontal wrist, loosely cupped raised fingertips; forearm unchanged
right_hand.note: T cross D = P. Right-hand supination reverses the world-space thumb side; no reflection or negative scale.

chest_study.decision: B / frame selected by the user for V4; A retained for comparison. Game build still selects V3.

revision: Palette-only derivative; pending visual and balance review

material_study.method: Direct block-state remap of accepted V4.1. No geometry regeneration or voxelization.
material_study.source_preview_note: Editable source shows the bulk palette. Non-rendering empties mark salvage areas; exact voxel masks are post-export.
